# Mahdi Salek

## Introduction

Building web products that feel intentional.

Mahdi bridges the gap between user experience, product logic, and high-performance frontend engineering. Specializing in Vue and Nuxt, he builds intuitive dashboards, data-dense interfaces, and resilient web applications that turn complex workflows into effortless user experiences.

### Core stack

- Vue (https://vuejs.org/): UI framework
- Nuxt (https://nuxt.com/): Application framework with SSR
- Vuetify (https://vuetifyjs.com/): Component systems
- TypeScript (https://typescriptlang.org/): Type-safe development
- Pinia (https://pinia.vuejs.org/): State management
- i18n (https://i18n.nuxtjs.org/): Internationalization

## About

From complex requirements to clean interfaces.

Product-minded development across dashboards, admin tools, data-heavy views and feature-rich web applications.

Great frontend engineering isn't just about rendering mockups—it’s about understanding why a feature exists and who it serves. Mahdi's day-to-day work covers data-heavy interfaces, internal tools, and customer-facing products where UX friction directly impacts adoption.

He cares deeply about edge cases: smooth empty states, optimistic updates, offline resilience, and accessible interactions. Whether architecting scalable state with Pinia or cutting initial load times with Nuxt SSR, his goal is always to deliver speed, clarity, and reliability to the end user.

### Key facts

- Vue & Nuxt Ecosystem: SSR, fast first paint & SEO-ready web products
- Architecture & Scale: Design systems, composables & clean state trees
- Product & UX Focus: Accessibility (a11y), responsive UX & resilient error states
